challenge.en: Scaling 3D optical measurement to 12 stereo pairs (24 cameras) on an active line.
challenge.zh-TW: 將 3D 光學量測擴展至產線 12 組立體相機（24 顆相機）即時檢測。

solution.en: Designed system architecture, deterministic hardware trigger sync bus, and tuning specs.
solution.zh-TW: 主導系統架構設計、硬體觸發同步匯流排與跨部門調校規格。

boundary.en: Advanced prototype MVP to factory-ready production testing before product launch.
boundary.zh-TW: 推進成果：量測原型進入工廠上市前的產線上線測試階段。

en.summary: Led system design, hardware integration, and boundary testing for a {cameraPairs}-stereo-camera line.
details: Advanced a C++/Python 3D-measurement MVP to factory-ready production testing.
Defined test specifications and analyzed results to guide cross-functional hardware tuning.
en.boundary: Stage reached: production testing before product launch.

zh-TW.summary: 負責 {cameraPairs} 組立體攝影機產線的系統設計、硬體整合與邊界測試。
zh-TW.result: 量測原型 → 工廠上線前測試
details: 將 C++／Python 3D 量測原型推進到工廠上線前測試。
定義測試規格、分析成果，支援跨部門硬體調校。
zh-TW.boundary: 階段：產品上市前的量產測試。
